info.name: Petstore API tests
info.description:
API tests for pets in Swagger Petstore.

Positive tests: valid requests. Run any request on its own.
Negative tests: invalid data or a pet that does not exist. Run any request on its own.
E2E: connected scenarios. Open Pet life cycle and run the whole scenario from step 1. Current scope is the Pet API workflow, not a full shop process.

Each independent test prepares and removes its own data.
For Upload a pet photo, select fixtures/pixel.png in Body if needed.

Some negative tests fail because the public server differs from its API documentation. Details are in NOTES.md.
See README.md for a quick start. Scope: Pet API only.
